SET TOGETHER WITH A PARENT

Finish a meaningful stage and unlock a reward you care about.

Child and parent decide together. Rewards recognize persistence, explanation, and growth—not only correct answers.

When it is earned

Complete 30 distinct missions, including the stage showcase. Missing a day never removes the reward.

Who decides

The child suggests and the parent confirms. Rewards can be changed later.

Healthy rewards

Prefer time together, meaningful choices, experiences, and chances to create.

12 STAGE REWARDS FOR THIS GRADE

THE PARENT ROLE

Explain less. Ask one better question.

Parents do not need to prepare lessons or finish work for the child.

01

Before

Ask, “What do you think you will discover?” Let the child start.

02

When stuck

Ask, “What was different from what you expected?” Do not demonstrate immediately.

03

After

Ask, “Can you explain it in your own words?” Clarity matters more than speed.

TRANSPARENT BUILD

See the true status of every part we add.

A page existing does not mean a lesson is finished. Content goes live only after content, technical, and child-experience checks.

Live prototypeAdaptive reviewPlanned

Six release checks for every mission

  1. Clear TEKS and prerequisite skills
  2. One clear learning goal in 10 minutes
  3. Answers, models, and explanations independently checked
  4. A child can operate it and error feedback helps
  5. Accurate, natural, age-appropriate Chinese and English
  6. No major comprehension or usability barrier in child testing
